entities.summary: Barásoain is a town and municipality in the autonomous community of Navarre, northern Spain, within the historical lands of the Basque Country. located approximately 25 km south of Pamplona, the provincial capital. As of 2019 the population stood at 621. Nordex has a production facility of nacelles.
